{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis lacks formal hypothesis test",
      "quote": "The pCR rate per independent central pathology review along with 95% exact confidence interval will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical hypothesis section states a null and alternative hypothesis for the primary endpoint, but the primary efficacy analysis only describes calculating a confidence interval, with no mention of a formal hypothesis test (e.g., one-sample exact test) or p-value. This is a gap in the analysis plan.",
      "fix": "Specify the formal hypothesis test to be used for the primary endpoint, including the test statistic and how the p-value will be computed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for health-related quality of life endpoint",
      "quote": "Health-related quality of life, as assessed using the EORTC QLQ-C30",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint for health-related quality of life is listed, but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan for this endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for the EORTC QLQ-C30 endpoint, including scoring, handling of missing data, and summary measures."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Incidence of ADA for cemiplimab",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint for immunogenicity is listed, but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan for this endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for the immunogenicity endpoint, including how incidence will be summarized and any subgroup analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for cost implication endpoints",
      "quote": "Change in estimated costs due to change in surgical plan during screening period versus actual surgical procedure performed after neoadjuvant cemiplimab",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoints for cost implications are listed, but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan for these endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for the cost endpoints, including how costs will be estimated and compared."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for patterns of failure endpoint",
      "quote": "Patterns of failure in patients with local, regional, or distant disease recurrence as measured by descriptive statistics",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint for patterns of failure is listed, but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan for this endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for patterns of failure, including how the patterns will be categorized and summarized."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is pCR rate assessed by independent central pathology review.",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint lacks a full estimand specification: population (FAS is defined later, but not linked), variable (pCR rate), intercurrent events (e.g., patients who do not undergo surgery), and summary measure (proportion) are not fully described in the endpoint section.",
      "fix": "Provide a complete estimand for the primary endpoint, including handling of intercurrent events such as patients who do not have surgery."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The pCR rate per independent central pathology review along with 95% exact confidence interval will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe how missing pCR data will be handled, e.g., patients who do not undergo surgery or have missing pathology review.",
      "fix": "Specify the handling of missing data for the primary endpoint, including sensitivity analyses if needed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size assumption not justified",
      "quote": "Seventy-two (72) patients will be required to provide 80% power to reject a null hypothesis of a pCR rate of 25% at a 2-sided significance level of 0.05 if the true pCR rate is 44%.",
      "page": 72,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size calculation is stated, but the assumed true pCR rate of 44% is not justified with a reference or clinical rationale.",
      "fix": "Provide a justification for the assumed true pCR rate of 44%."
    }
  ]
}
